module Main (main) where

import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import Data.List (foldl')

main :: IO ()
main = do
  input <- BS.getContents
  let ws = map (maybe 0 fst . BS.readInt) (BS.words input)
      (m : n : _) = ws
      sieve = sieveTo n
      result = [i | i <- [m..n], sieve !! i]
  mapM_ (BS.putStrLn . BS.pack . show) result

sieveTo :: Int -> [Bool]
sieveTo n = go initial 2
  where
    arrSize = n + 1
    initial = replicate arrSize True
    go arr i
      | i * i > n = arr
      | arr !! i  = go (mark arr (i * i) i) (i + 1)
      | otherwise = go arr (i + 1)
    mark arr start step =
      [ if j == start || (j >= start && (j - start) `rem` step == 0) then False else arr !! j
      | j <- [0 .. n]
      ]

module Main (main) where

import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import Data.Array.Unboxed (UArray, listArray, (!), bounds)

main :: IO ()
main = do
  input <- BS.getContents
  let (m : n : _) = map (maybe 0 fst . BS.readInt) (BS.words input)
      sieve = sieveTo n
      result = [i | i <- [m..n], sieve ! i]
  BS.putStr (BS.unlines [BS.pack (show i) | i <- result])

sieveTo :: Int -> UArray Int Bool
sieveTo n = go initial 2
  where
    initial :: UArray Int Bool
    initial = listArray (0, n) (True : replicate (n - 1) True ++ [False] `orIf` []) `seq`
              listArray (0, n) (replicate (n + 1) True)
    go arr i
      | i * i > n = arr
      | arr ! i  = go (markMultiples arr i) (i + 1)
      | otherwise = go arr (i + 1)
    markMultiples arr p = arr `seq` arr // [(j, False) | j <- [p * p, p * p + p .. n]]

orIf :: a -> a -> a
orIf = const

module Main (main) where

import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import Data.Array.Unboxed (UArray, listArray, (!))
import Data.Array.ST (STUArray, newArray, readArray, writeArray, runSTUArray)
import Control.Monad (forM_, when)

main :: IO ()
main = do
  input <- BS.getContents
  let (m : n : _) = map (maybe 0 fst . BS.readInt) (BS.words input)
      sieve = sieveTo n
      primes = [i | i <- [m .. n], i >= 2 && sieve ! i]
  BS.putStr (BS.unlines [BS.pack (show i) | i <- primes])

sieveTo :: Int -> UArray Int Bool
sieveTo n = runSTUArray $ do
  arr <- newArray (0, n) True :: STUArray s Int Bool
  writeArray arr 0 False
  when (n >= 1) $ writeArray arr 1 False
  let lim = floor (sqrt (fromIntegral n :: Double)) :: Int
  forM_ [2 .. lim] $ \i -> do
    p <- readArray arr i
    when p $ forM_ [i * i, i * i + i .. n] $ \j -> writeArray arr j False
  return arr
